answer: Like basalt laid over centuries, each identity must grow a deep, public foundation - years of visible work no one can fake overnight - to earn trust. The network then strikes each identity like a crystal and listens to the ring: an honest identity rings with its own unique tone, shaped by its own history, while farm identities all ring in perfect unison, forged from one same mold in one same forge. That shared ring betrays them. To pass, a farm must lay a separate basalt foundation and tune a separate crystal for every sockpuppet, each slowly and in the open - as expensive as honest work.
